resources.string: Raises the voices over music and effects. Works best on 5.1/7.1 audio. Not applied with audio passthrough.
Night mode: quiet scenes louder, explosions and loud music softer.
Raises the volume above 100% (up to +10 dB). Saved for each audio output device.
Raises the voices over music and effects (centre channel on 5.1/7.1, voice band on stereo). Also adjustable from the player Audio panel.
Night mode: reduces the gap between quiet and loud scenes. Independent from the dialogue boost.
